A Pack as an Optional Parameter - Braden Ganetsky - CppCon 2025
---

With fold expressions landing in C++17, using parameter packs is more expressive than ever before. Now we can do some tricks with variadics that make our code so much cleaner. This lightning talk shows off a fun trick of using fold expressions to make the parameter pack behave as a parameter that is optionally specified.
